_readme: Config template for the LinkedIn post pipeline. Place config.json inside the directory you point LINKEDIN_TEMPLATES_DIR at, or name it linkedin_config.json next to the scripts. With no live config file anywhere, the three scripts (linkedin_render.py, linkedin_voicebook_check.py, linkedin_lever_check.py) behave byte-identically to their built-in defaults.

_notes.url_allowlist: Regex list; any match marks a URL public (used by the LINK slot gate, the checker link-line gate, and selection viability). app.notion.com is always rejected in code, regardless of config. The factory default when no config exists is the substring rule example.org.
_notes.template_dir: Only consulted when LINKEDIN_TEMPLATES_DIR is not set; the env var wins.
